scenes.headline: How Qwen-Drive bolts driving onto an unmodified VLM
scenes.sub: A planning expert and a BEV head, attached to Qwen3.5-4B's stock architecture.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Thistle! Qwen-Drive answers questions, sees in 3D and plans a path, all from one backbone with no new layers inside. Here's how.

scenes.text: Leave the vision-language model's architecture untouched. Two external heads read what it already computes: a planner reads its attention caches, a perception head taps its features.
scenes.say: The idea: don't rebuild the vision-language model. Attach heads that read what it already computes, with no new layers inside it.

scenes.title: One backbone, two heads that read it

steps.say: Cameras and a prompt go into Qwen3.5-4B, loaded as the stock class. Ask a question, and it answers like any vision-language model.
A perception head taps the vision patches and the final hidden state, and builds a bird's-eye view. The backbone is fine-tuned alongside it.
A separate one-billion-parameter planner reads the key-value caches of the backbone's eight attention layers. No layer is spliced into the backbone.
Speed, acceleration and the driving command condition every planner layer. Out comes a five-second path at ten hertz.

items.say: At each step, the expert predicts the finished trajectory, not a velocity.
Six samples cost one backbone pass, because the scene cache is computed once and shared.

left.title: Queried once
left.say: Reinforcement learning looks like a clean win on benchmarks that query the planner once.

right.title: Closed loop, AlpaSim
right.say: In a simulator that re-runs the planner as the scene changes, it halves off-road driving, but gives up progress. It's a trade.

scenes.text: You can teach a vision-language model to drive without rebuilding it: attach heads that read what it already computes.

recap: A 1.04B planner reads its 8 attention caches
RL wins open loop; closed loop shows a trade
scenes.say: To recap: a stock backbone, heads that read instead of rewrite, and a closed loop that shows the trade.
